designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1963 when the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service began acquiring waterfowl production areas in the Rainwater Basin of south-central Nebraska.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Hunting and Conservation Stamp Act (Small Wetlands Acquisition Program)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Rainwater Basin Wetland Management District, About Us
Federal Register, July 18, 2007 (E7-13887): "Rainwater Basin WMD was established in 1963 when the Service began acquiring" waterfowl habitat

review.note: Year confirmed. Wetland management district built from waterfowl production area purchases.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: It was established in 1963 when the Service began acquiring critical migratory waterfowl habitat in southeastern Nebraska.
